author: Harshita Sharma
source: मैं हर सुबह छह बजे उठता हूँ।
references: I wake up at six every morning.
I get up at 6 o'clock every morning.

author: Harshita Sharma
source: कृपया दरवाज़ा बंद कर दीजिए।
references: Please close the door.
Please shut the door.

author: Harshita Sharma
source: कल रात बहुत तेज़ बारिश हुई।
references: It rained very heavily last night.
There was very heavy rain last night.

author: Harshita Sharma
source: मेरी बहन दिल्ली के एक अस्पताल में डॉक्टर है।
references: My sister is a doctor at a hospital in Delhi.
My sister works as a doctor in a hospital in Delhi.

author: Harshita Sharma
source: क्या आप मुझे स्टेशन का रास्ता बता सकते हैं?
references: Can you tell me the way to the station?
Could you show me the way to the station?

author: Harshita Sharma
source: बच्चे पार्क में फुटबॉल खेल रहे हैं।
references: The children are playing football in the park.
Kids are playing football in the park.

author: Harshita Sharma
source: इस किताब की कीमत तीन सौ रुपये है।
references: This book costs three hundred rupees.
The price of this book is 300 rupees.

author: Harshita Sharma
source: हमें पानी बचाना चाहिए।
references: We should save water.
We must conserve water.

author: Harshita Sharma
source: मुझे खेद है कि मैं समय पर नहीं पहुँच सका।
references: I am sorry that I could not arrive on time.
I'm sorry I couldn't get there on time.

author: Harshita Sharma
source: दादी रोज़ शाम को बगीचे में टहलती हैं।
references: Grandmother takes a walk in the garden every evening.
Grandma walks in the garden every evening.

author: Harshita Sharma
source: मुझे चाय में चीनी कम पसंद है।
references: I like less sugar in my tea.
I prefer my tea with less sugar.

author: Harshita Sharma
source: आज दफ़्तर में बहुत काम था।
references: There was a lot of work at the office today.
I had a lot of work at the office today.

author: Harshita Sharma
source: क्या आप थोड़ा धीरे बोल सकते हैं?
references: Can you speak a little slower?
Could you speak a bit more slowly?

author: Harshita Sharma
source: बाज़ार आज बंद रहेगा।
references: The market will remain closed today.
The market will be closed today.

author: Harshita Sharma
source: उसने अपनी परीक्षा अच्छे अंकों से पास की।
references: She passed her exam with good marks.
He passed his exam with good marks.

author: Harshita Sharma
source: हम अगले साल गोवा घूमने जाएँगे।
references: We will go on a trip to Goa next year.
Next year we will visit Goa.

author: Harshita Sharma
source: बच्चों को सड़क पार करते समय सावधान रहना चाहिए।
references: Children should be careful while crossing the road.
Children must be careful when crossing the street.

author: Harshita Sharma
source: मेरा फ़ोन चार्ज नहीं हो रहा है।
references: My phone is not charging.
My phone isn't charging.

author: Harshita Sharma
source: यह रास्ता स्टेशन की ओर जाता है।
references: This road leads to the station.
This way goes to the station.

author: Harshita Sharma
source: कल सुबह से लगातार बारिश हो रही है।
references: It has been raining continuously since yesterday morning.
It has been raining non-stop since yesterday morning.

author: Harshita Sharma
source: मैंने अभी तक खाना नहीं खाया है।
references: I haven't eaten yet.
I have not had my meal yet.

author: Harshita Sharma
source: दादाजी हर रविवार को अख़बार पढ़ते हैं।
references: Grandfather reads the newspaper every Sunday.
Grandpa reads the newspaper on Sundays.

author: Harshita Sharma
source: इस दुकान में सब कुछ आधे दाम पर मिल रहा है।
references: Everything in this shop is available at half price.
Everything is half price at this shop.

author: Harshita Sharma
source: कृपया अपना टिकट दिखाइए।
references: Please show your ticket.
Please show me your ticket.

author: Harshita Sharma
source: हमें पेड़ लगाने चाहिए ताकि हवा साफ़ रहे।
references: We should plant trees so that the air stays clean.
We must plant trees to keep the air clean.
